lead.title: Butterfly Medical wins MDR certification for its prostatic retraction implant for benign prostatic hyperplasia
lead.deck: The implant, validated in a 244-patient pivotal study, relieves urinary obstruction without removing, cutting or heating prostate tissue. Its PMA application is under FDA review, and the company raised $21M in a Series C in May 2026, including from the EIC.

milestone.title: VitVio deploys its Vetro AI surgical operating system at the University Clinical Centre in Gdańsk (UCK)
milestone.summary: Vetro combines computer vision and ambient sensors to build a live 3D model of the operating room, log surgical milestones and flag delays. The pilot covers a few orthopaedic and neurosurgery theatres, with Polish distributor Medim handling installation.
milestone.why: A first European hospital deployment for a company founded in 2024, after an $8M seed led by Bek Ventures (LDV Capital, Balnord): a sign the product is moving from demo to the operating theatre.

deal.thesis: Agilent is buying Proscia (Concentriq Dx digital pathology platform, FDA-cleared in 2024) for $240M cash plus up to $30M in earn-outs, with closing expected in fiscal 2027. A valuation comparable for regulated diagnostic software, not an entry opportunity.

brefsEurope.title: UK regulator MHRA unveils its 2030 strategy: scientific advice cut from 90 to 45 days
brefsEurope.summary: The strategy also promises better access to real-world data on devices, AI-proficient analysts to spot safety signals faster, and a simpler Yellow Card reporting system.

brefsEurope.title: Stride raises £4.6M seed for its preventive health platform (DNA, blood, gut testing)
brefsEurope.summary: Founded in 2024 by Andrew Steele, the company counts Arāya Ventures, Morgan Stanley Inclusive & Sustainable Ventures and Better Ventures among its backers; the lead is not named. Stride One is due to launch internationally before end-2026.

brefsIntl.title: FDA clears Providence Medical's CORUS PCSS 3D-T for posterior cervical fusion
brefsIntl.summary: Bilateral 3D-printed porous titanium implant with integrated screw fixation, supplied as a single-use sterile kit, for stabilisation alongside posterior cervical fusion.

word.fr: FDA premarket approval for Class III devices
word.definition: The FDA's most demanding authorization route, reserved for high-risk (Class III) devices: the maker must prove safety and effectiveness with clinical data, often a pivotal trial.

how.t: The maker runs a trial, often randomized and blinded, under an FDA IDE exemption.
It submits clinical, preclinical and manufacturing data to the FDA.
The FDA reviews the file (nearly 599 days on average in H1 2026) and issues an approval order.

word.why: A PMA is a moat: costly and slow, it protects the few approved devices. For a VC, approval is the catalyst that unlocks US revenue and often triggers a raise or an acquisition.

startups.name: Butterfly Medical
startups.use: Prostatic retraction implant for BPH; 244-patient pivotal study complete, PMA application under FDA review; CE-marked and MDR-certified.

startups.name: ProVerum
startups.use: ProVee System (nitinol expander for BPH) FDA-approved via PMA (P250011) on Dec 9, 2025, based on the sham-controlled ProVIDE study.

startups.name: Zenflow
startups.use: Zenflow Spring implant for BPH FDA-approved in December 2025; $52M Series D led by Cook Medical, now its US distributor.
